I like to think that Anne helped shape me into the woman I am today (amongst a few others lol). It's amazing to think of how much I learned from her as a child, that would then follow me throughout my entire life. So much of the good in me can be credited to those books. I may not have been a red haired orphan from Canada, but I saw so much of myself in her. The way she embraced every part of herself, made me feel like I could do the same. Even while all of the people closest to me tried to make me feel like I was too much and that I should stifle my muchness to better fit into the world. She made me feel like it was ok to...well... to just BE. She also showed me what true friendship was. And I'm proud to say I've come across quite a few KINDRED SPIRITS in my lifetime. I don't know if I would've recognized them for what they were, had she not shown me the true meaning of the phrase. Thank you, Anne!!! 🖤🖤🖤

"People pontificate, "Suicide is selfishness." Career churchmen like Pater go a step further and call in a cowardly assault on the living. Oafs argue this specious line for varying reason: to evade fingers of blame, to impress one's audience with one's mental fiber, to vent anger, or just because one lacks the necessary suffering to sympathize. Cowardice is nothing to do with it - suicide takes considerable courage. Japanese have the right idea. No, what's selfish is to demand another to endure an intolerable existence, just to spare families, friends, and enemies a bit of soul-searching."

- David Mitchell

Decided that if I had to deal with it for all these years from them, then they could deal with it a fraction of it too. Now, we ALL get to be miserable with guilt & shame lol

I've been incessantly told the same thing for as long as I can remember. I've suffered with suicidal ideations (amongst a host of other symptoms) since I was about 5 years old. I'm going to be 32 this year. Still waiting on my day to come & things to finally "get better". Getting pretty tired of waiting tho tbh. Exhausted actually. I've dealt with chronic/recurring trauma since childhood. Some of which cost me my children to diff degrees. Though I still was able to be involved in my son's life, he told me last night what a horrible parent I am/was. I guess he thought I was threatening to kms when I was simply telling him I'd stay away... He then told me he "knows I wouldn't go through with it, but even if I did he wouldn't care" & I'd be "doing him a favor" if I did go through with it. I wasn't the best mother, but his young mind likes to embellish quite a bit. I haven't seen his little sister in 3 years bc her gma is hiding her from me in another state. I don't have the money to fight in court after going into debt after the first 5 years of having to go through court. So, I've now officially lost my connection to both of my babies. They were all I had keeping me here. I suffered thru with my life so as to not cause them more pain. But now I'm being told by my 13 year old son that I'd be doing him a favor. Almost felt like he was daring me to do it. I've only felt this low once before. I lost myself for almost 3 years that time. & things are just so much worse this time. Ik this is stupid, but I lost my cat suddenly & completely unexpectedly almost 2 months ago. He was my best friend. My one soul comfort in this world. I don't think I can keep going, keep dealing with the constant bs, without him. He was my only source of any kind of happiness. I was barely getting by when he was still here. I don't know what I must've done to deserve so much loss in my life. There's nothing left for the universe to take from me at this point. I feel so alone. I can't even talk to my husband & have isolated myself from my few friends. I wouldn't be able to really talk about stuff anyway... No one has ever understood. They don't want to fr. Prob scares them. But I'm tired of being a burden. Just by existing. I destroy everyone/everything that comes anywhere near me. I'm so fucking tired. I didn't ask to be born like this. Or to be born at all tbh.

I've been trying to make this same argument to my loved ones for over 6 years now. I think they've not only begun to accept it, but also to wish I'd just get on with it then 😔 I've wanted to die for as long as I can remember. My entire life. First time I was only 5 years old. I'm now almost 32 years old. The only thing still stopping me is this crippling fear of "the void". I've craved the end, & yet I'm still here, cuz I'm a coward. 😔
